scope: CSS DOM text samples only. Exact solid-background computed pairs and a separately reviewed bound for the two observed gradient declarations. No pixel/occlusion, icons, borders, focus ring, placeholders, hover/pressed coverage, physical device or full WCAG certification.
gradient_review: Week radial RGB channels remain between #e9eee0 and #fff8ed; opaque dark text is below every background channel. Luminance monotonicity bounds contrast by the darkest background. Account gradient has cream alpha stops over the identical opaque cream base. Full CSS chains have no group opacity/filter/blend/generated background/text shadow. This is a CSS bound, not sampled pixels or axe completion.
